comparisons.name: messages-compose-light
comparisons.description: The compact form: the compose button of Messages, Aqua. The glyph is Messages' own artwork and is masked; the conversation list behind the button is vibrant in the capture and a flat measured colour here. What remains is in the corners: the capture's are rounder than the standard bezel's.
